Bc.bar_b_note: A clean naturalistic moss surface carries it, but one flat mid-green with no readable eyes and no rim or accent colour falls short of Palworld creature finish.

Sm.bar_b_note: Side A's moss read is believable but flat in value, and side B's lime-and-black camouflage sinks it to placeholder level.

Fy.bar_b_note: B's removed banners, broken crates, opened cage and smoke tell the aftermath, but smeared ground textures, flat grey-green light, sparse low-poly trees and stretched wall textures sit far below Palworld density and Valheim light.

Sb.bar_b_note: The naturalistic armoured boar with real fur and stone plates is close to the owner's style bar, but crushed-black faint frames (A) and red lava seams with reddened tusks (B) keep it short of shipping finish.

Ud.bar_b_note: The spider is visible, but murky unlit frames, flat magenta telegraph rings, an invisible player creature, no storm sky or lightning, HUD panels over a third of the frame and (A) camera-in-canopy frames sink it.

Tj.bar_b_note: A warm, readable stylised elder with clear eyes and an earthy green-brown palette matching the key art's trainer carries it; only a slightly plastic skin sheen holds it back.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight framing: pull the camera out of the canopy and fade trunks and leaves between the camera and the fighters, light the fight with the purple storm sky and white-violet lightning, replace the flat magenta telegraph rings with real ground cracks or lightning strikes, and shrink or translucent the HUD panels.

Meadows ground and light in the trainer-site scenes: replace the smeared ground textures with grass groves, flower clusters and dirt edges, add a warm key light with cast shadows and cool blue distance, and fix the stretched textures on the fort walls.

Creature material value structure: give the moss creature visible orange eyes, a darker belly and accent veins per its Stormwood board, keep the boar's faint frames out of crushed black, and remove red seams and red tusks from friendly creatures.
